name: adspendspy
description: Research Meta ads and estimated ad spend with AdSpendSpy, and rebuild top-spending landing pages for your own offer.

interface.shortDescription: Meta ad spend research and landing-page rebuilds
interface.longDescription: AdSpendSpy connects Codex to your tracked Meta advertisers: their ads, estimated spend and the landing pages that receive the most ad spend. The rebuild-landing-page skill turns a top-spending landing page into a structural blueprint and rebuilds it for your own offer with original copy. Without an API key, the public demo covers Alex Hormozi.
defaultPrompt: Rebuild the top landing page of Alex Hormozi for my coaching offer
Which landing page of this advertiser gets the most ad spend?
